title: Answer: a measurement is one recorded path, the recording party still open

statements.text: A measurement is a record: a path of the quantum rule, one branch at every split chosen by a deterministic key, is what one observer would record. The quantum enters at the fear beat, the one gate outside the Clifford group (E-QTM-0118). What counts as the recording party is open. A self is a region of vibes, so it could be the environment that records a result, but on the working rule nothing correlates across mesh lines to pick what gets recorded (E-QTM-0154).
statements.scope: open. The measurement and Wigner's friend rows of the ledger are not reached
